Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 nullchk;

 -- Check that effective date is >= today

 then

 then
 show_error ('5003');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-RECORD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
if :system.record_status in ('NEW','INSERT','CHANGED')
then
 if :attributes.eff_date is null
 then
 show_error ('5002');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end if;
--
-- Check that effective date is >= today
--
 if :system.record_status in ( 'NEW','INSERT')
 then
 if trunc(:attributes.eff_date) < trunc(sysdate)
 then
 show_error ('5003');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
--
 if :attributes.term_date is not null
 then
 if trunc(:attributes.term_date) < trunc(:attributes.eff_date)
 then
 show_error ('5004');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
end;
